findings.description: Round-1 fixes verified: `_blame` now reports the all-zero sha when HEAD is unborn (re-running the reproduction gives status `uncommitted`, exit 0), and an OSError while reading the target becomes the one-line exit-2 InputError. The fix request scoped only why_trace.py, so regression tests for both paths belong in skills/tests/explain-code/test_why_trace.py as a follow-up commit; no further code change is needed.
